newsitem.title: CHINA: China 1996 copper exports up 2.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: China 1996 copper exports up 2.5 pct.

text.p: China's exports of uncast and raw copper climbed 2.5 percent to 133,708 tonnes in 1996 from a year ago, customs figures showed on Thursday.
Exports of uncast and raw copper in Decmeber alone were 30,301 tonnes, it said. Exports for 1995 were 130,392 tonnes.
Exports of uncast copper including alloys rose 23.1 percent to 53,003 tonnes in 1996.
Exports of uncast copper including alloys reached 14,335 tonnes in December alone.
China's imports of uncast and raw copper rose 32.7 percent to 714,248 tonnes in 1996, the figures showed. Imports in 1995 were 537,879 tonnes.
Imports of uncast and raw copper reached 86,856 tonnes in December alone.
Imports of uncast copper including alloys were up 55.1 percent to 290,945 tonnes in 1996.
Imports of uncast copper including alloys were 37,161 tonnes in December alone.
